label: GO step after an unrewarded trial, early in the episode (a2-biased)
explanation: Fires almost only at the GO step (97.7% of mass; never at D1, a little at D2 only when S1 is reached). Within GO it is gated by an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward 0 holds 84% of mass; never active when the reward input is 1) and by episode time: rate falls from ~17% in trials 0-9 to ~0 after trial 70, so it is an early-episode unit. Magnitude is highest when the agent is choosing a2 (80% of mass on action a2, policy logit strongly toward a2) and the previous choice was a2; top windows are runs of unrewarded a2 choices early in the episode. Predicate uses only observed variables (previous reward, episode position, phase). It misses weaker activations after rewarded trials and many unrewarded early GO steps do not fire (precision ~0.5), so the description is incomplete; the episode-time gating suggests a slowly drifting hidden-state component rather than a discrete event.
